name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Bound persistent holiday storage to the real current year and following year only. At calendar-module startup, erase holiday bit-cache files for older/future years and old cache versions. Keep only two decoded year bitsets in RAM. Pages wholly within current/next year use the 46-byte yearly bit caches; if a scroll reaches any page outside that two-year window, do not create or save a yearly cache and instead calculate only that visible 35-day page transiently, then apply its holiday colors together. Japan and all three UK regions follow the same policy.
